Revision History

Asio 1.38.2

  • Added a "scheduler" / "assume_continuation" configuration parameter. When true, the scheduler assumes that all posted handlers are a continuation of the currently executing handler, allowing them to be added to a fast thread-local queue. This can improve performance for applications that exclusively use short-running handlers.
  • Added a "reactor" / "io_uring_ring_count" configuration parameter. This sets the number of independent io_uring instances ("rings") that a single execution context maintains internally. Increasing this parameter from its default of 1 may improve scalability when the execution context is used with multiple threads.
  • Added a "reactor" / "io_uring_ring_size" configuration parameter, which is used to specify the number of entries in each io_uring instance.

Asio 1.38.1

  • Added optional binary versioning using an inline namespace. If the preprocessor macro ASIO_ENABLE_VERSION_NAMESPACE is defined, Asio will compile all symbols under an inline namespace that includes the version number. Alternatively, users can specify a custom inline namespace name by defining ASIO_VERSION_NAMESPACE directly. This allows different versions of Asio to coexist in the same process without symbol conflicts. The inline namespace is disabled by default to avoid breaking existing code that forward declares Asio names.
  • Changed the default Windows mutex implementation from CRITICAL_SECTION to SRWLOCK.
  • Added a "slim" mutex implementation based on std::atomic. When supported by the compiler and OS, this reduces the size of the state required for strands, sockets, and other descriptors.
  • Added support for compilation under Cygwin64.
  • Added support for using Cygwin without __USE_W32_SOCKETS, allowing the POSIX socket API to be used in place of the Winsock API.
  • Added the ability for users to override ASIO_DECL before including Asio headers. This may be used to override symbol visibility attributes, or to disable the DLL import/export decoration.
  • Fixed MSG_NOSIGNAL handling on NetBSD, which supports the flag regardless of _POSIX_VERSION.
  • Fixed the build with recent Boost versions, which no longer support linking against boost_system.
  • Fixed compatibility with musl libc on older versions of Android.
  • Fixed detection of std::aligned_alloc on older Apple platforms.
  • Fixed a warning in serial_port_base::character_size::store when compiling with MSVC.
  • Clarified the IPv4 vs IPv6 semantics of ip::multicast::outbound_interface in the documentation.
  • Updated TLS v1.3 context initialisation to correctly detect LibreSSL support (available from LibreSSL 3.2.0).
  • Fixed compatibility with the latest OpenSSL's X509 constness changes.
